title: 第9章 另有隐情第10章 看谁捶死谁
slug: 未婚当奶娘可她婴语满级啊
content_zh:
第9章另有隐情！
“小儿黄病？不是牛乳的问题？”
老夫人难以置信的发问。
王翠娥、沈春花顺势火上浇油：“一定是她手脚不干净，接触到了牛乳，才把病气过给了小公子。”
“少夫人、老夫人，你们千万不能轻易饶了她！”
“闭嘴，你们两个口口声声说我的牛乳有问题？你们有证据吗？
若是没有证据，我可是要告你们污蔑之罪！”
苏念禾一身正气，丝毫不带怕的。
她才不会掉入自证的陷阱，既然你们挑事，那就拿证据来说话。
看来昨天的警告她们全当作了耳边风，口中无德，是会遭报应的。
王翠娥、沈春花自然没有证据，她们就是想借机给苏念禾泼脏水，好把她赶出府。
顺便在老夫人面前露个脸，刷刷存在感。
自张嬷嬷宣布留下苏念禾当奶娘起，她们就一直盯着婴儿屋里的动静。
一听到丫鬟喊不好了，小公子变成小黄人了，就想好了说辞。
一直念叨着一定是苏念禾喂牛乳出了问题，这奶孩子哪有喂牛乳的？
这话又恰巧被着急忙慌赶来的老夫人听了去，顿时火冒三丈。
侯府的小公子，那绝对是她的心头肉，好好的奶娘不用，喝什么牛乳？
于是，老夫人立马带人去拿苏念禾。
王翠娥，沈春花听到苏念禾要反告她们污蔑之罪，继续嚷嚷道：“牛乳不是一直在你身上吗？你有胆子就让孙府医来验！
谁知道你弄来的牛乳有没有什么瘟病？”

孙府医也惊讶不已：“牛乳？什么牛乳？
生牛乳吗？”
他一拂袖：“简直胡闹！小儿的肠胃脆弱，根本没有办法吸收生牛乳。
就是煮开的熟牛乳，肠胃不适，喝了也有可能害痢疾！”
苏念禾要的就是这个时机，顺势就将那小罐配方奶粉拿了出来。
既然自己说的没人信，那就借孙府医给自己正名。
“喏，孙府医，就是这个。这可不是生牛乳，而是经过高温烘焙特殊工艺制成的奶粉。
里面还添加了很多促进婴儿吸收的成分，安全有营养。”
孙府医打开盖子，不曾想竟是粉末状的？
他倒出一点在手掌上，奶香扑鼻，粉质细腻均匀，比最好的研磨器研磨的都要细致。
自己行医多年，还是头一次见！
他用银针试过，没有变黑，说明里面无毒。
紧接着望闻问切，又用舌尖尝了一点点，顿时眼睛一亮。
“口感绵密丝滑，真是好味道！不知平时是如何喂给小公子的？”
“先倒入烧开后晾温的水，再加入这个奶粉，摇至均匀后就可以给小公子喝了。”
孙府医连连赞叹：“妙哉，妙哉！这个工艺太精湛了，冲服起来还如此方便！
这要是能多生产，岂不是可以解不少产妇没奶之困啊！”
content_en:
Chapter 9 has another secret!
"Children's yellow disease? Isn't it a problem with milk?"
The old lady asked in disbelief.
Wang Cui'e and Shen Chunhua added fuel to the fire: "It must be that her hands and feet were unclean and came into contact with milk, so she passed on the illness to the young master."
"Young Madam, Old Madam, you must not let her go easily!"
“Shut up, you two keep saying there’s something wrong with my milk? Do you have any evidence?
If there is no evidence, I will sue you for slander! "
Su Nianhe looked upright and showed no fear at all.
She will not fall into the trap of self-evidence. Since you are making trouble, let the evidence speak for itself.
It seems that yesterday's warning fell on deaf ears. Their words are unethical and they will be punished.
Wang Cui'e and Shen Chunhua naturally had no evidence. They just wanted to take the opportunity to throw dirty water on Su Nianhe and drive her out of the house.
By the way, show your face in front of the old lady to make your presence felt.
Ever since Grandma Zhang announced that Su Nianhe would be left as the nanny, they had been watching the movements in the baby room.
As soon as the maid heard that the young master had turned into a minion, he thought of an excuse.
He kept thinking that there must be something wrong with Su Nianhe's feeding of milk. How could this baby be fed milk?
This happened to be heard by the old lady who came in a hurry, and she suddenly became furious.
The young master of the Marquis Mansion is definitely her pet peeve. If she doesn’t need a good nanny, why should she drink milk?
So, the old lady immediately took people to get Su Nianhe.
When Wang Cui'e and Shen Chunhua heard that Su Nianhe was going to sue them for slander, they continued to shout: "Isn't the milk always on your body? If you have the guts, let Dr. Sun Mansion come and examine it!
Who knows if the milk you got has any diseases? "
Doctor Sun was also surprised: "Milk? What kind of milk?
Raw milk? "
He flicked his sleeves and said: "That's nonsense! Children's intestines and stomachs are fragile and there is no way to absorb raw milk.
Even boiled milk can cause gastrointestinal discomfort, and drinking it may cause dysentery! "
Su Nianhe wanted this opportunity, so he took out the small can of formula milk powder.
Since no one believes what he says, he can use Doctor Sun to clear his name.
"Here, Doctor Sun, this is it. This is not raw milk, but milk powder made through a special process of high-temperature baking.
It also contains many ingredients that promote baby's absorption, making it safe and nutritious. "
Doctor Sun opened the lid, but he didn't expect it to be in powder form?
He poured a little bit on the palm of his hand. The milky aroma was fragrant and the powder was fine and even, even finer than the best grinder.
I have been practicing medicine for many years, but this is the first time I have seen him!
He tried it with a silver needle and it didn't turn black, which meant it was not poisonous.
Then I looked, smelled and asked about it, and tasted a little bit with the tip of my tongue, and my eyes suddenly lit up.
"The texture is dense and silky, and it tastes really good! I wonder how you usually feed it to the young master?"
"First pour in the water that has been boiled and allowed to warm, then add the milk powder, shake until even, and then you can give it to the little boy to drink."
Doctor Sun repeatedly praised: "Wonderful, wonderful! This technology is so exquisite, and it is so convenient to take it!
If this can lead to more births, wouldn’t it be able to relieve the problem of many mothers having no milk? "
